bias.en: Bearish · holding the Sep 3 low and 200-day
bias.zh: 偏空 · 守住 9月3日低点和 200 日均线

read.en: Arm edged up 0.1% on Oct 19 to $228.05 on light volume, fading from $236.42 to close near the day's low of $227.69. It is below the falling 5-day ($238.8), 10-day ($258.8), 30-day ($275.8) and 100-day ($294.5) averages and just above the rising 200-day ($224.0). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 7 and below zero, Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Sep 28 ($281.5), and RSI is 34.6.
read.zh: Arm 10月19日缩量微涨 0.1%，收于 $228.05，自 $236.42 回落，收于当日低点 $227.69 附近。股价位于下行的 5 日（$238.8）、10 日（$258.8）、30 日（$275.8）和 100 日均线（$294.5）下方，略高于上行的 200 日均线（$224.0）。MACD 自 10月7日起位于信号线及零轴下方，抛物线 SAR 自 9月28日起看空（$281.5），RSI 为 34.6。

read.en: No level changed: the bounce stopped below the $238 resistance and the close held above the $225.5–226.7 zone (Sep 3, Oct 15 and Oct 16 lows). Resistance is $236.4–239.4 (Oct 19 and Oct 16 highs, 5-day average), then $244.8 (Oct 15 close) and $258.8 (10-day). Support is $225.5–226.7, then $224.0 (200-day) and $219.4 (Aug 3 low). A close below $224 would open $219.4.
